coordinate.no_other_coordinate: no class is tuned independently; no shot noise; no change to cells, topology, efficacies or kernel

criterion.pass_predicate: P(lambda) = prospective_v2 check class_rate_bands true (E [2, 30], PV/SST/VIP [1, 80] Hz, every analysis window) for the fresh run at lambda
criterion.estimator: operation.window_summary rates: spikes per neuron per window / 5 s, class mean
criterion.reported_not_gating: all other prospective_v2 checks (isi_cv_by_class, active_fraction_by_class, E_het, sync, drift), active fraction, ISI fraction, rate CV, sync per window; per-transition class rate jumps

procedure.1_bracket: fresh runs at lambda 0, 0.5, 1; keep the final engine state of the lambda 0 and lambda 1 runs
procedure.2_endpoint_reproduction: per class per window, |rate(lambda 0) - results/v21_mid.json| and |rate(lambda 1) - results/v21_high.json| <= 0.5 Hz; otherwise UNRESOLVED and stop
procedure.3_bisection: while some adjacent pair of evaluated lambdas has differing P and width > 0.0625, evaluate its midpoint (lowest such pair first); at most 12 bisection runs, otherwise UNRESOLVED
procedure.4_single_interval: the evaluated lambdas with P true must be consecutive in sorted order; otherwise UNRESOLVED (non-monotone)
procedure.5_interior: if no evaluated lambda in (0, 1) has P true: FAIL
procedure.6_candidate: passing run [lo, hi] = lowest and highest evaluated passing lambdas; candidate lambda_c = (lo + hi) / 2, evaluated fresh if not already evaluated; margin = distance from lambda_c to the nearest evaluated failing lambda. UNRESOLVED if P(lambda_c) is false or the passing run stops being consecutive (non-monotone), or margin < 0.125 (interval too narrow to hold an interior point away from the boundary)
procedure.7_state_dependence: run lambda_c for 20 s continuing from the final state of the lambda 0 run and, separately, of the lambda 1 run (engine key and step index continue from that state). Each must give the same P and, per class, a 3-window mean rate within max(1 Hz, 10% of the fresh lambda_c rate); otherwise UNRESOLVED (hysteresis or state dependence)

classification.COUPLED_BACKGROUND_PASS: a finite interior passing interval exists: steps 2-7 hold
classification.COUPLED_BACKGROUND_FAIL: no evaluated interior lambda satisfies all class-rate bands (step 5)
classification.COUPLED_BACKGROUND_UNRESOLVED: endpoint non-reproduction, bisection budget exhausted, non-monotone pass set, narrow interval, or state dependence at the candidate

candidate_status: lambda_c and its tonic vector are reported, not frozen; the reviewer freezes the operating point
discontinuity_note: a rate jump at the passing boundary (e.g. PV recruitment) is recorded per transition and does not by itself block classification; it blocks only through steps 4, 6 or 7
